shortDescription: Manage Connection Authorization Policies (CAP) on a Remote Desktop Gateway server

options.name: allow_only_sdrts_servers
options.description: Specifies whether connections are allowed only to Remote Desktop Session Host servers that enforce Remote Desktop Gateway redirection policy.

options.name: auth_method
options.description: Specifies how the RD Gateway server authenticates users. When a new CAP is created, the default value is C(password).

options.name: computer_groups
options.description: A list of computer groups that is allowed to connect to the Remote Gateway server.

options.name: idle_timeout
options.description: Specifies the time interval, in minutes, after which an idle session is disconnected. A value of zero disables idle timeout.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the connection authorization policy.

options.name: order
options.description: Evaluation order of the policy. The CAP in which I(order) is set to a value of '1' is evaluated first. By default, a newly created CAP will take the first position. If the given value exceed the total number of existing policies, the policy will take the last position but the evaluation order will be capped to this number.

options.name: redirect_pnp
options.description: Allow Plug and Play devices redirection.

options.name: session_timeout
options.description: The maximum time, in minutes, that a session can be idle. A value of zero disables session timeout.

options.name: session_timeout_action
options.description: The action the server takes when a session times out. C(disconnect): disconnect the session. C(reauth): silently reauthenticate and reauthorize the session.

options.name: state
options.description: The state of connection authorization policy. If C(absent) will ensure the policy is removed. If C(present) will ensure the policy is configured and exists. If C(enabled) will ensure the policy is configured, exists and enabled. If C(disabled) will ensure the policy is configured, exists, but disabled.

options.name: user_groups
options.description: A list of user groups that is allowed to connect to the Remote Gateway server. Required when a new CAP is created.
